communication_goal: 标明过时规则，更新范围，并先确认新计划。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The adult stick-figure programmer stands at the left of a small table, holding a pencil over a large open spiral-bound notebook lying flat at center. The two blank pages, spiral binding and entire page edges are clearly visible. Keep the pencil tip just above the page so it does not obscure the notebook. The white OpenAI knot floats to the right. Thoughtful face, revising a plan. No eraser, readable writing or other objects.

image_review.summary: 通过：单幅黑底白线，一个火柴人和一个可辨认的 OpenAI 六环结标识，无底图对白文字。双页螺旋笔记本、装订和页边完整可见，铅笔轻触页缘不遮住主体；白色纸页仍为纯黑白平面。
